column1: # Cards that are never built: oracle_id<TAB>name<TAB>reason.
# The owner's plan (29.09.2026) implements the whole corpus set by set, in
# release order by first printing, and "the whole corpus" leaves out four
# kinds of card on purpose. Each is banned in every sanctioned format, and
# none of them can be played by a rules engine as printed:
#   ante       - plays for ante (CR 407). "When not playing for ante,
#                players can't include these cards in their decks or
#                sideboards" (CR 407.3), and no table here plays for ante:
#                its stakes are cards from each player's collection.
#   dexterity  - asks a physical act of the player (Chaos Orb's flip), which
#                no game state describes.
#   subgame    - starts a game within the game (CR 728, Shahrazad), which
#                this engine, one game per process, does not host.
#   un-set     - an Un-set card whose text needs something outside the
#                rules (owner, 13.10.2026): fractional or infinite mana
#                (City of Ass, Urza's Fun House; CR 107.1a allows neither),
#                printed text in place of Oracle errata (R&D's Secret Lair),
#                a website (Urza's Fun House). Only the Un-cards whose
#                printed text cannot be played go here; an Un-card the
#                rules can play is built like any other.
# A card is listed here after its oracle text was read, never from its name.
# It is never added to data/card-pool.txt, and a set is counted complete
# without it. Keep one row per card, the reason one of the four words above.
